concept_evolve.py.purpose: Cross-domain concept tree generation and traversal for research projects

commands.evolve: Launches sub-agent to research a topic across multiple domains, generate concept cards, semantic bridge graph, introspection data, and steering directions. Creates tree/ folder structure with concept.json and README.md per concept. Cached for 7200s.
commands.probe: Deep concept probe on a specific bottleneck. Generates associations, forced_bridges, anomaly_results, steering_directions, validation_checks. Writes probe_result.json.
commands.reframe: Reframes a problem in 8+ distinct domains with concrete techniques. Writes reframings.json with domain, reframing, key_insight, suggested_technique, mapping_back fields.
commands.walk: Traverses existing walk_paths.json (generated by evolve). Filters by seed, controls depth. Outputs selected paths.

concept_evolve.py.implementation: Launches OpenCode sub-agents via subprocess to do actual research. Sub-agents have access to websearch, webfetch, semantic_scholar, bash, read, write, edit. Python post-processes filesystem artifacts (concept folders, adjacency graph, walk paths).
interconnections: Sub-agent model configurable via CONCEPT_EVOLVE_MODEL env var

semantic_scholar.py.purpose: Robust literature graph traversal via Semantic Scholar API

capabilities.search: Full-text search returning paperId, title, authors, year, citationCount, abstract, externalIds, venue, url
capabilities.citations: Get papers citing a given paper
capabilities.references: Get papers referenced by a given paper
capabilities.recommend: Get recommendations based on positive paper IDs
capabilities.graph: Build citation graph from seed query with configurable roots and fanout
capabilities.bibtex: Generate BibTeX entry for a paper ID

semantic_scholar.py.api_details: Uses Semantic Scholar Graph API v1 with 6-retry exponential backoff. Fields: paperId, title, authors, year, citationCount, abstract, externalIds, venue, url.
interconnections: Can save results to JSON files

opencode.json.purpose: OpenCode configuration defining model, agents, tools, and permissions

logs/.purpose: Stores execution logs from archivara agents

reviewer.description: Peer review and quality control worker

evolve.purpose: Generate cross-domain concept tree for a research topic
evolve.input: Topic string describing the research problem
evolve.output: concept_cards.json (array), semantic_bridge.json (graph), introspection.json, steering_directions.json, tree/ folder hierarchy
evolve.mechanism: Spawns sub-agent with 900s timeout, up to 2 attempts. Sub-agent researches via websearch/S2, generates 10+ concept cards, builds semantic bridge graph, produces steering directions.
evolve.caching: Results cached for 7200s based on normalized topic string

probe.purpose: Deep probe of a specific bottleneck or open question
probe.output: probe_result.json with associations, forced_bridges, anomaly_results, steering_directions, validation_checks
probe.mechanism: Spawns sub-agent with 480s timeout, up to 2 attempts

reframe.output: reframings.json with domain, reframing, key_insight, suggested_technique, mapping_back per framing
reframe.mechanism: Spawns sub-agent with 360s timeout, up to 2 attempts

walk.mechanism: Pure Python, reads pre-computed walk_paths.json from evolve

semantic_scholar_capabilities.search: Query-based paper search with configurable limit (default 10)
semantic_scholar_capabilities.citations: Forward citation traversal from paper ID
semantic_scholar_capabilities.references: Backward reference traversal from paper ID
semantic_scholar_capabilities.recommend: Paper recommendations from positive seed papers
semantic_scholar_capabilities.graph: Full citation graph construction with configurable roots and fanout
semantic_scholar_capabilities.bibtex: BibTeX entry generation from paper ID
